about: Spruce Grove is a suburban city immediately west of Edmonton on Highway 16A, adjoining Stony Plain and Parkland County. It grew from a railway siding into a family-oriented commuter city of new neighbourhoods around a small downtown. The TransAlta Tri Leisure Centre, shared with its neighbours, is the main recreation campus. About 38,000 people live in Spruce Grove.
